newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian police, demonstrators clash -one dead.
newsitem.headline: Albanian police, demonstrators clash -one dead.

text.p: Anti-government protesters clashed with police in the southern Albanian port of Vlore on Sunday, leaving one person dead and 36 injured, officials said.

A doctor at the city hospital said a man in his 40s died of a heart attack after protesters pelted the town's main police station with stones and police responded by shooting into the air. The doctor said many of the injured had buckshot wounds.
Demonstrators accused police of being responsible for the victim's death and said he was covered in blood when taken to hospital.

Eyewitnesses said thousands of protesters had moved on the station after the fifth consecutive day of demonstrations through the city to demand refunds of money lost in failed pyramid investment schemes.
Some protesters marched out of Vlore in the late afternoon to set up roadblocks on the main road linking the city with Tirana to prevent police reinforcements being dispatched from the capital.

Angry depositors launched the protests last week after the collapse of a local investment scheme with about $500 million in debts. Police initially tried to halt the protesters but eventually allowed them to move freely through the town.
